assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE SMALL standalone industrial SCENE PROP sprite for the pump-house of the 1990s coastal pixel-art survival game 潮汐线. References are STYLE AND CAMERA ONLY: muted weathered gray-green machinery, deliberate crisp pixel-art clusters, compact readable silhouette, upper-left highlights. Camera is the project's HIGH 75-degree ORTHOGRAPHIC overhead view: TOP surfaces dominate, only short SOUTH/front and thin darker EAST/right faces visible; no isometric diamond, no strong low-angle product view, no front-facing technical poster, no perspective convergence. Mostly dull gray-green painted cast iron, dark steel and sparse orange-brown rust at bolts and edges, modest damp grime, no extravagant corrosion. Prioritize simple readable outlines at about 32–48 pixels, not photoreal microtexture. ONE complete uncut object centered on genuinely transparent canvas, fills about 80–85% with transparent margins. No floor, room, pipes extending beyond canvas, large foundation slab, cast shadow, people, text, numbers, labels, logos, UI, glow or sci-fi details. SUBJECT: a compact STANDALONE CENTRIFUGAL WATER PUMP HOUSING, WITHOUT an attached electric motor. Chunky snail/volute-shaped cast-iron casing with clearly curved round top housing, bolted cover rim, one large SHORT circular inlet flange pointing toward screen left, one SHORT outlet flange pointing screen up, small exposed coupling hub toward screen right. Flange holes and the volute shape should read clearly from above. Two short built-in mounting feet with bolt holes, no long skid base. Dull gray-green paint, edges worn to dark steel, tiny rust at flange bolts. Industrial water pump rather than turbine, fan, fuel engine or entire pump-and-motor installation. Single small compact mechanism, nearly square overall outline, clear top view.
